user.title: ZyTemp CO2 monitor
user.description: A sensor was found at {path}. Add it to Home Assistant?

error.no_device: No ZyAura ZG01 sensor found. Check that it is plugged in, and that /dev is shared with the container if Home Assistant runs in one.
error.permission_denied: The sensor was found but could not be opened. Install the udev rule so that the hidraw node is readable.
error.cannot_connect: The sensor was found but did not answer.

abort.already_configured: The sensor is already set up.

data_description.co2_warning: The warning alarm turns on above this level.
data_description.co2_critical: The critical alarm turns on above this level. Both alarms clear 50 ppm below their threshold so they do not flap.
data_description.temperature_offset: Added to every reading. The sensor sits next to the electronics and tends to read 1-3 °C high.

error.critical_not_above_warning: The critical threshold must be higher than the warning threshold.
